items.title: Will AI Become BAC's Next Major Efficiency & Growth Lever?

items.title: Bank of America hikes S&P 500 target after Al trade cracks
items.summary: The bank raised its 2026 year-end target to 7,400 and set a 12-month goal of 7,800, closing out a losing bet against Alphabet and Meta in the process.

items.title: Investors Expect AI Growth to Continue, BofA Survey Shows
items.summary: Nearly 35% of investors who responded to Bank of America's September credit investor survey expect little meaningful regulation in the artificial intelligence industry in the near term. Another 22% of respondents said regulation could have an insignificant impact on AI capital expenditure.

items.title: Will JPMorgan's Selective M&A Strategy Expand Growth Runway?
items.summary: JPM's selective M&A approach is likely to add payments, data and technology capabilities while keeping organic growth at the center of its expansion strategy.

items.title: Bank of America Stock Fell 8% Last Week After Its CEO Spoke at an Industry Conference. Here’s What He Said That Spooked Investors.
items.summary: Key TakeawaysGuidance Shock: Bank of America stock fell 7. 91% for the week ended September 18, dropping from $63 to $58 after CEO Brian Moynihan guided Q3 investment banking fees down more than 10% year over year to $1.

items.title: Bank of America Sets 12-Month S&P 500 Target at 7,800, Sees 2% Upside
items.summary: Bank of America (BofA) has introduced a 12-month target of 7,800 for the S&P 500, implying approximately 2% upside from current levels, while raising its year-end forecast and identifying several risks to US equities. In a note published this week, strategist Savita Subramanian increased the bank’s year-end target to 7,400 from 7,100.
